descriptions.zh: 文件打包下载接口, 返回异步任务 id, 需要使用 GetAsyncTask 方法获取任务执行状态。
descriptions.en: This asynchronous operation archives files and folders into a single package and returns an asynchronous task ID. To check the status of the task, call `GetAsyncTask`.
